summary: Honeywell Aerospace Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the effectiveness of its Form 10 registration statement and the upcoming spin-off from Honeywell International Inc. On the distribution date of June 29, 2026, Honeywell shareholders will receive one share of Honeywell Aerospace common stock for every two shares of Honeywell common stock held as of the June 15 record date, with cash paid for fractional shares. The filing also notes the appointment of Pascal Desroches as an independent director and audit committee chair. The information statement was mailed to stockholders. What to watch: the spin-off distribution ratio and the start of when-issued trading.
